python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64, json, zlib
payload = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode("")).decode())
for path, content in payload["files"].items():
    target = Path(path)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if target.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing to overwrite existing new file: {path}")
    target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
for path, old, new in payload["replacements"]:
    target = Path(path)
    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if new in text:
        continue
    if old not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f"replacement needle missing in {path}")
    target.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")
PY
